director_rationale: The independent review is adopted. All eight candidates are directly supported by current MLIT 教則第5版, are applicable to second-class scope, and preserve distinct answer-defining reasoning boundaries against the released 188-question bank. C008 remains distinct from Q065/Q139 because its trigger is low battery or anticipated inability to continue after failsafe has already activated, requiring a landing transition. The other seven candidates cover responsibility designation, authority communications, PPE, planning despite familiarity, weather deterioration action threshold, Version 5 insurance requirement, and emergency landing priority without duplicating an existing canonical proposition.
